target: Comet 3I/ATLAS (interstellar comet) in SPHEREx QR2 level-2 spectral images
field_center_note: Comet's predicted position at the middle epoch (epoch 3, 2025-12-14T07:39:58Z); all cutouts requested with identical center/size so field stars register across epochs
pixel_coordinate_convention: PNG pixel coordinates, origin at TOP-LEFT corner, x increasing right, y increasing down, in the delivered 900x900 PNGs
orientation: North up, east to the left (standard sky orientation). The IRSA cutout arrays are already display-oriented (RA decreases with column, Dec decreases with row), so no flip was applied; reprojection preserved this.
processing: IRSA cutout service (?center=&size=) on QR2 level-2 files -> IMAGE extension (full detector band: D2 1.103-1.650 um for epochs 1-3, D3 1.630-2.435 um for epochs 4-5) -> reprojected onto epoch-3 WCS grid (293x294) with reproject_interp -> per-image median background subtracted -> shared asinh stretch (scale = 99.9th percentile of all epochs) -> subtle blue tint (R,G,B = 0.80,0.89,1.00 x intensity) -> bilinear resize to 900x900
